security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by clinical terminology, Markdown backticks, and Python dictionary keys. The real risks are local scripts that write to user-supplied paths and privacy-sensitive workflows that can preserve or send patient details. No prompt injection attempt, credential harvesting, malicious network code, or command injection evidence was found.

remediation.issue: Local scripts write to user-supplied output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Warn before overwriting files, validate output paths, and prefer writing inside an explicit workspace directory.

remediation.issue: Figure-generation guidance can send clinical details to an external AI workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Make external figure generation optional and require de-identification before any external tool or model receives clinical content.

remediation.issue: The de-identification checker records raw identifier examples.
remediation.suggestion: Mask or hash detected examples by default, and require an explicit flag to include raw matched text.

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code keeps example matches from identifier patterns and writes the full report when --output is set. This is a direct privacy risk for clinical text, even though the tool runs locally.

content.value_statement: Clinical teams need consistent reports that follow medical, privacy, and regulatory standards. This skill provides templates, reference guidance, and validators for clinical reports.
actual_capabilities: Draft CARE-style case reports using the included case report template.
Create diagnostic report structures for radiology, pathology, and laboratory findings.
Prepare serious adverse event and clinical study report sections from trial guidance.
Generate SOAP notes, H&P documents, discharge summaries, and consult notes.
Run local checks for de-identification, terminology, and report completeness.
Format adverse event summary tables from CSV trial data.
limitations: Does not replace clinician judgment, diagnosis, or licensed medical review.
Validation scripts use pattern checks and can miss context-specific privacy issues.
Regulatory guidance must be checked against current institutional and jurisdiction requirements.
Some visual workflow integrations may require separate skills or files not included here.

use_cases.title: Prepare a publishable case report
use_cases.description: Build a CARE-aligned manuscript outline, timeline, consent checklist, and de-identification review before journal submission.

use_cases.title: Standardize clinical documentation
use_cases.description: Create SOAP notes, H&P documents, consult notes, and discharge summaries with consistent clinical sections.

use_cases.title: Support clinical trial reporting
use_cases.description: Draft SAE reports, CSR sections, and adverse event tables using ICH-E3 and CONSORT-oriented references.

prompt_templates.title: Start a clinical note
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a SOAP note template for a follow-up visit. Include placeholders for subjective, objective, assessment, and plan sections.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a case report outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a CARE-style case report outline for a de-identified patient case. Include title, abstract, timeline, discussion, and consent sections.

prompt_templates.title: Review privacy and terminology
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this de-identified draft for possible HIPAA identifiers, prohibited abbreviations, missing sections, and unclear clinical terminology.

prompt_templates.title: Build a trial safety section
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an adverse event reporting section for a phase 3 clinical study. Include seriousness, causality, expectedness, MedDRA coding, and table guidance.

output_examples.input: Create a CARE-style case report outline for an unusual infectious disease presentation.
output_examples.output: A structured outline with title, abstract, patient information, timeline, diagnostic assessment, intervention, outcomes, discussion, and consent reminders.

output_examples.input: Check a discharge summary for completeness and privacy issues.
output_examples.output: A review summary listing missing sections, possible identifiers, medication clarity issues, follow-up gaps, and recommended edits.

output_examples.input: Summarize adverse events for a two-arm clinical trial.
output_examples.output: A publication-ready table description with treatment arms, total participants, event counts, percentages, serious events, deaths, and discontinuations.

best_practices: De-identify all patient details before using templates, validators, or external tools.
Have a qualified clinician review all clinical content before release or submission.
Use institutional policies and current regulations as the final authority.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated reports as final medical, legal, or regulatory advice.
Do not paste identifiable patient data into prompts or external image tools.
Do not rely on pattern-based validators as the only privacy review.

faq.question: Can this skill diagnose patients?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure documentation and reports. Diagnosis and treatment decisions require qualified clinical review.

faq.question: Does it include templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes templates for case reports, diagnostic reports, trial reports, SOAP notes, H&P notes, and discharge summaries.

faq.question: Can it check for HIPAA identifiers?
faq.answer: Yes. A local script can scan for common identifiers, but manual privacy review remains required.

faq.question: Does it support clinical trial reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for SAE reports, clinical study reports, CONSORT-style reporting, and adverse event tables.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Should identifiable patient data be used?
faq.answer: No. De-identify patient information before using this skill, especially before any external generation or sharing workflow.
